# konomigami-lib

> 紙 konomigami-lib · the fold algebra · 7 base glyphs + 6 mutations · state algebra · bloom ↔ integer ↔ sequence · φ-coherence · pure JS · zero deps · v20.4 socket VI · prime 677 · MIT · substrate by Thomas Frumkin

konomigami-lib is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
